stories.title: Locust Grove overpass, eastbound I-84 lanes closed in Meridian
stories.summary: A "commercial vehicle" has hit the bridge at Locust Grove overpass and Interstate 84, according to Idaho State Police.

stories.title: 2027 St. Jude Dream Home breaks ground in Eagle
stories.summary: Construction has begun on the 2027 St. Jude Dream Home in the Valnova master-planned community off State Highway 16.

stories.title: Chronic wasting disease detected in Idaho mule deer along Snake River
stories.summary: A mule deer buck harvested along the Snake River has tested positive for chronic wasting disease. Idaho officials said it is the first positive detection in Unit 13.

stories.title: Treefort adds Grammy-nominated act to 2027 festival lineup
stories.summary: The downtown Boise music festival unveils Grammy-nominated hyperpop artist underscores as a Friday headliner.

stories.title: Idaho gas prices fall below $4 ahead of Thanksgiving travel
stories.summary: Idaho drivers are getting some relief at the pump ahead of Thanksgiving travel. According to AAA Idaho, the state's average gas price has fallen below $4 per gallon.

stories.title: Back to the basics: Navigating traffic signals and explaining their purpose
stories.summary: The Ada County Sheriff’s Office emphasizes using caution and following Idaho law when driving through signalized intersections.

stories.title: Warmer, not drier: Rain and snow keep rolling through
stories.summary: The daily forecast from Idaho's trusted KTVB First Alert Weather team.

stories.title: Chubbuck bans commercial kratom sales
stories.summary: Chubbuck City Council unanimously passed an ordinance on Wednesday banning kratom sales, citing health concerns and lack of regulation.

stories.title: Turning the key for the next family: Former CATCH client helps raise thousands for the nonprofit that helped her start over
stories.summary: After fleeing domestic violence, Brittany Love found a home through CATCH. She and Black Bear Diner Boise just raised money to help the next family do the same.

stories.title: U.S. Treasury approves 25 new Opportunity Zones for investment growth across Idaho
stories.summary: The designations offer tax incentives to investors, with nine of the new zones qualifying for enhanced benefits aimed at encouraging investment in rural communities.

stories.title: Downtown Boise's 8th Street project nears the finish line, business owners hope new look boosts foot traffic
stories.summary: After months of transformative construction, Boise's 8th Street fully reopens Thanksgiving, revealing enhancements aimed at boosting business and accessibility.

stories.title: Ada County Sheriff's Office warns public about jail bond scams
stories.summary: Authorities said scammers are targeting the loved ones of recently incarcerated people by posing as bondsmen or sheriff's office representatives.
